import csv, hashlib, io, json, re
from pathlib import Path
source = Path('products/services/agency-launch-qa-pilot/buyer-report-control.csv')
raw = source.read_bytes()
reader = csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(raw.decode('utf-8-sig')))
rows = list(reader)
assert rows and reader.fieldnames
refusals = [i for i,row in enumerate(rows, 2) if re.search(r'\b(refus\w*|inconclusive|unverified)\b', ' '.join(str(value) for value in row.values()), re.I)]
report = {'source': str(source), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 'columns': reader.fieldnames, 'control_rows': len(rows), 'rows_marked_for_refusal_or_uncertainty_review': refusals, 'scope': 'Synthetic report inspection only. A host refusal must stay outside the confirmed successful and confirmed broken link counts. Text matches indicate rows for review and do not certify the tally.'}
path = source.with_name('director-control-tally-review.json')
path.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
